name: Chellarams
source: Chellarams Plc audited consolidated and separate financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (group column), _ngx_pdf/CHELLARAM.pdf p.27, with the directors' report highlights on p.11, unit NGN thousands x 1000.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: Stored as Gross Profit less Operating Profit so the printed identity Gross Profit less Operating Expenses equals Operating Profit holds; it is the selling and distribution plus administrative expenses (2,674,259 and 1,866,434 thousand) less the printed other operating income (773,085 and 713,327 thousand).

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.derivedFormula: Net Finance Costs = Operating Profit (EBIT) - Profit Before Tax

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: The charge, stored positive: Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the printed profit for the year (657,521 less 375,650 = 281,871; -2,571,801 less 5,165 = -2,576,966, thousands).

rows.label: EPS
rows.derivedFormula: EPS = profit attributable to owners of the parent / ordinary shares in issue
rows.note: Group basic and diluted EPS in the filing is 28 kobo (2026) and -262 kobo (2025), struck on the profit attributable to owners of the parent (199,676 and -1,890,514 thousand) over 722,926 thousand shares; stored here in naira.

source_note: Group column. The filing prints only two group years (2026 and 2025) and no five year summary, so FY2024, FY2023 and FY2022, which this file used to carry, are not certified and are removed: the values it held for them were the company and prior-year columns of the same two-year statement, misread as single years.
